verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's own API docs explicitly state 'you can use the FireHydrant API to configure integrations, define incidents, and set up webhooks--anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI,' directly claiming full UI/API parity, and API keys default to Owner permissions enabling full account-level actions (docs-21, docs-33, docs-48).  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of parity, a discoverable public OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s), and confirmation that newer UI features (e.g., AI retrospectives, analytics dashboards) are all exposed via API.
